claim: For labelled subset-sector weights C_S with C_empty=1 and normalized marginal purities F(T)=D_T Tr(rho_T^2), F(T)=sum_{S subseteq T} C_S and C_S=sum_{T subseteq S}(-1)^(|S|-|T|)F(T).
interpretation: All proper labelled sector weights are determined by proper marginal purities. The top-order sector additionally requires the global purity; this sharpens, rather than contradicts, Cycle 084's proper-marginal no-go.
novelty_boundary: Not promoted: multipartite Bloch/sector-length literature already relates sector lengths and reduced purities by exact transforms.
